description: Used to display scrollable items. Supports horizontal and vertical orientation.

props.centerActive: Forces the selected component to be centered.
props.contentClass: Adds classes to the slide group item.
props.direction: Switch between horizontal and vertical modes.
props.mobileBreakpoint: Sets the designated mobile breakpoint for the component.
props.nextIcon: The appended slot when arrows are shown.
props.prevIcon: The prepended slot when arrows are shown.
props.scrollDistance: How far the arrows scroll, in pixels or as a percentage of the area within container
props.scrollSnap: Snap items while scrolling or using the arrows.
props.showArrows: Change when the overflow arrow indicators are shown. By **default**, arrows *always* display on Desktop when the container is overflowing. When the container overflows on mobile, arrows are not shown by default. A **show-arrows** value of `true` allows these arrows to show on Mobile if the container overflowing. A value of `desktop` *always* displays arrows on Desktop while a value of `mobile` always displays arrows on Mobile. A value of `always` always displays arrows on Desktop *and* Mobile. Use **never** to turn arrows off. Find more information on how to customize breakpoint thresholds on the [breakpoints page](/customizing/breakpoints).

events.edge: Emitted when scrolling reaches the start or the end of the group.

exposed.hasNext: Returns true if there are items after current index.
exposed.hasOverflow: Returns true while the content does not fit in the container.
exposed.hasPrev: Returns true if there are items before current index.
exposed.scrollOffset: Current scroll position, in pixels from the start of the container.
exposed.slide: Scroll the group: `prev` or `next` moves one step like the arrows do, `{ by }` overrides the step with pixels or a percentage of the visible area, and `{ index }` reveals an item. Snaps to items when **scroll-snap** is set.
